# Warranty

Every appliance carries a 24 month manufacturer warranty from the invoice
date, covering parts and labour. Batteries and lamps are covered for 6 months.

Register the serial number within 90 days of purchase and the cover extends to
36 months at no charge.

The warranty excludes accidental damage, corrosion, and any repair carried out
by a third party. An approved claim is collected, repaired and sent home
inside 10 working days.
